senses.gloss: āmlavetasa, m. (= Skt. amla˚, and lex. āmla˚), n. of a plant, a kind of sorrel, Rumex vesicarius: Mvy 〔5780〕 = Tib. star bu, acc. to Jäschke Hippophae rhamnoides, but ‘acc. to a Lex. also a kind of sorrel in India.’

āmlāyati, caus. to ā-mlā (in Skt. only in āmlāna; caus. of mlā in Skt. is mlāpayati), causes to wither: fut. medio-passive (pass. force) LV 〔335.5〕 āmlāyiṣyase … bodhisattvena, you shall be made to wither by the B. (said to Māra).
